svg.title: HyperWeave — unframed hero, adaptive
svg.desc: HyperWeave hero banner, adaptive (prefers-color-scheme): whisper laminar caustics with luminance-vignette edge fusion, cushion-gem geometry glyph and wordmark sharing one surface-matched DNA (top-lit ink on light, ionized pearl on dark), subtitle flush to the H.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: One hero, three emissions: native light, native dark, and a single adaptive file for surfaces that flip.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Both approved hero treatments carried without change into a themed build system: the light scheme is the v3.6.1 set (whisper field 0.30/0.12, ink lockup, near-white vignette) and the dark scheme is the v3.5 set (full field 0.50/0.28, ionized lockup, void vignette). The adaptive emission renders two field groups gated by prefers-color-scheme classes while the lockup renders exactly once, its fills routed through CSS custom properties — the wordmark path is never duplicated. Glyph is the cushion-gem geometry in every emission, filled with its surface wordmark ramp so mark and type stay one metal per scheme.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Ionized ramp v2 fixes the dark waist streak: the 56 percent #184880 trough sat 8.2x below its bright neighbor — a perceptual hole cutting every glyph — now lifted to #2E6AB8 at 54 percent with a fast 62 percent recovery (3.7x jump), keeping the chrome horizon without the dead band. The adaptive file shares one filter pair across both schemes, so the right-biased light orbits (the blue-on-blue fix) also drive the dark field — a small divergence from the dark-native file, paid for halving the filter count; surfaces that never flip should embed the native emission. Adaptive carries both field groups (~1.6x weight of a native file).
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Approved v3.5/v3.6 set: mark (128,146) scale 0.98, wordmark translate(178.4,-711.6) scale 1.6 (H flush x240.4, cap 104.4-187.6), subtitle x240.4 y246. Vignette sides 120, top/bottom 64, opaque at the boundary in each scheme substrate hue.

svg.text: The artifact layer for agent-human representations
